# pip-audit advisory baseline.
#
# pip-audit has no --ignore-vuln-file, so ci.yml builds the flags from this file
# (grep -v "^#" | sed "s/^/--ignore-vuln /" | xargs). Keeping the list here instead
# of inline in ci.yml is what makes it reviewable: 40-odd of these were appended
# one commit at a time with no recorded reason.
#
# Granularity is by ADVISORY ID, not by package, on purpose: a new advisory in an
# already-ignored package still fails the build.
#
# RULES
#   - Add an entry only with a one-line reason on the same line as a trailing
#     comment. A bare ID is not reviewable and CI enforces the review date.
#   - REVIEW_BY is enforced: the "Audit baseline is current" step fails once the
#     date passes, so this list cannot renew itself silently. Bump it only after
#     re-auditing, not to silence the failure.
#   - PYSEC-2025-184 is a KNOWN UNPATCHED Spark advisory, not an oversight: the
#     3.5.x line has no fix. It needs tracking, not ignoring forever.
#
# REVIEW_BY=2026-12-24
#
# Format: <ID> [# <why>]

PYSEC-2025-184 # unpatched in pyspark 3.5.x; batch-only path, no untrusted deserialization. Needs a tracked issue, not permanent suppression.
